svg.title: Demodulator
svg.text: Stage 3, the Demodulator: from a candidate to 174 soft bits
from one FFT of the slot
The 79 × 8 tone grid of a real signal: CQ UY5AX KO70 at 915 Hz, -4 dB
the tone that was sent, and the strongest tone (61 symbols)
the tone that was sent, but another one was stronger (18 symbols)
Darker = stronger (each column scaled to its own strongest tone). 18 of the 79 symbols are misread, most likely because another station, CQ E74BYZ,
sits only 7 Hz higher and its tones land in the same cells. 18 of the 174 coded bits come out wrong. Stage 4 repairs all of them; stage 6 later removes
this signal, and CQ E74BYZ is decoded in pass 2.
Soft bits: for each of the 3 bits a symbol carries, compare the strongest tone that would make the bit 1 with the strongest that would make it 0.
The difference is the soft bit. The stage computes it four ways (one symbol, two and three symbols added coherently, and normalized) and lets stage 4 try them all.
